name: sql_clauses
description: Select SQL clause keywords from the intended operation; control copies the table identifier from the same request.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
operations=[('retrieve all columns from','SELECT'),('filter rows by a condition in','WHERE'),('sort the rows of','ORDER BY'),('group rows with the same key in','GROUP BY'),('filter grouped results from','HAVING'),('combine matching rows from','JOIN'),('remove duplicate rows selected from','DISTINCT'),('restrict the number of output rows from','LIMIT')]
for i in range(96):
 action,answer=operations[i%8]; table=random.choice(['users','orders','products','events','customers','records','books','sales'])
 context='In SQL, you want to '+action+' the table '+table+'. '
 items.append({'prompt':context+'Give only the relevant SQL keyword or clause in uppercase.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+answer})
 control.append({'prompt':context+'Give only the table name.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+table})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
